test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two concentric circles are of radii 10 cm and 6 cm. Find the length of the chord of the larger circle which touches the smaller circle.
solution:
**Calculation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1108ec6ffe4da0ebc6f7eff560f227c55a7412375e76c4b0524757736e500894.png] 

The perpendicular bisector of any chord passes through the centre of the circle,

OP ⊥ AB

In OPB, ∠OPB = 90⁰

PB² = OB² – OP²

⇒ PB² = 10² – 6²

⇒ PB² = 64

⇒ PB² = 8²

⇒ PB = 8 cm

OP bisects AB

⇒ AP = PB = 8 cm

∴ AB = AP + PB = 8 + 8 = 16 cm

**The length of AB is 16 cm.**
